question:
What does this Content Security Policy help prevent?
```html
<meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy" 
  content="script-src 'self'">
```
options: CSRF attacks by restricting origins
Inline script execution and external script injection
SQL injection by sanitizing input
CORS violations by blocking cross-origin requests
explanation: CSP restricts script execution to same-origin; prevents inline/external script XSS.

options: No issue because eval is a standard function
Extremely dangerous; eval executes arbitrary code
Safe if input is validated with regex
Only unsafe with malicious intent
explanation: eval executes user-supplied code with full privileges; never use with untrusted input.

options: Unsafe because JSON.parse can execute code
Safe because JSON.parse only deserializes data
Dangerous if object contains prototype pollution
Secure only with input length validation
explanation: JSON.parse only deserializes; objects cannot execute code (though prototype pollution is possible).
